svg.aria-label: The journey of one order through the services
svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.tspan: web -> gateway -> orders -> inventory hold | then events: payments -> inventory -> fulfillment -> orders -> notifications
Before any order: the drop opens by itself
While the customer waits: plain HTTP calls
After that nobody waits: every arrow here is an event (outbox -> SNS topic -> the consumer's own SQS queue)
tells the customer how it ended
